items.claim: CFO 稱 2030 年 Guyana 自由現金流將為 2025 年的 2 倍
items.quote: we're going to see 2x the level of free cash flow in 2030 than we saw in 2025
items.speaker: Neil Hansen

items.claim: 結構性成本節省累計目標 2030 年達 200 億美元
items.quote: we plan to get to $20 billion by 2030
items.speaker: Neil Hansen

items.claim: 結構性成本節省自 2019 年累計達 163 億美元
items.quote: Cumulative structural cost savings have increased to $16.3 billion since 2019
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: 排除生產稅與能源價格後，現金成本年增持平
items.quote: we're basically holding cash costs flat
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: Q2 暫時損失約 10% 上游產量（中東衝突）
items.quote: approximately 10% of our upstream production
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: 化學品利潤相較 Q1 增約 180%
items.quote: roughly 180% increase in chemical product margins
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: Energy Products 占各事業線獲利比重五年由約 9% 升至約 23%
items.quote: it's gone from about 9% to about 23% in the last 5 years
items.speaker: Neil Hansen

items.claim: CEO 預期煉油市場維持高利潤
items.quote: a very robust refining market with very high margins
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: CFO 回應煉油獲利低於市場預期：歸因於變數多，稱無根本疑慮
items.quote: no underlying concerns with how that business has performed
items.speaker: Neil Hansen

items.claim: 第五艘 FPSO Errea Wittu 預計年底前投產
items.quote: remains on track for start-up by the end of the year
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: Longtail 朝最終投資決策推進
items.quote: Longtail is on the path toward final investment decision
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: 正在評估第九艘 FPSO；計畫將於年底定案
items.quote: we are evaluating the potential for a ninth FPSO
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: Guyana 成本回收提前，產量權益（entitlement）將調整並反映在 2030 計畫
items.quote: our volume entitlements will change
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: CFO 說明 Guyana 已回收 550 億美元投資，稱此為自由現金流轉折點
items.quote: we fully recovered the $55 billion of investment
items.speaker: Neil Hansen

items.claim: 回應分析師框架提問：CFO 同意是自由現金流轉折而非單純權益下降
items.quote: That's very much an inflection into free cash flow.
items.speaker: Neil Hansen

items.claim: Guyana 去飽和（desaturation）時點因價格與執行而提前，原預期為今年稍晚或明年初
items.quote: that's obviously come forward now with where prices have been
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: Guyana 長期探勘仍有潛力，AI 工具辨識新探勘機會
items.quote: the tape hasn't run out on this play yet
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: Permian 單季產量創紀錄，超過 180 萬油當量桶/日
items.quote: more than 1.8 million oil equivalent barrels per day

items.claim: Permian 新增外送管線後，CEO 認為驅動力是無瓶頸外送與最大化油產
items.quote: the real driver will be unconstrained takeaway capacity
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.quote: have an advantage versus what others in the industry can do

items.quote: we have 1,200 wells

items.quote: continue to grow distillate, jet, and basestock production

items.quote: a 30% improvement in cost and a 60% improvement in duration

items.quote: there's going to be a continued inhibition for movement

items.quote: I can't really predict when it will happen
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.quote: We're in discussions with QE about that.
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.quote: we're not extrapolating current events

items.quote: we hope to FID that project later this year

items.quote: we won't shy away from the region

items.quote: best ever basestock margins

items.claim: Proxxima 產能擴建：下一階段摻配廠今年稍早已 FID，管理層稱滲透需時

items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: 本季資本支出約 70 億美元
items.quote: Cash capital expenditures were roughly $7 billion
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.quote: we returned more than $9 billion to shareholders
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.claim: 全公司流程與數據平台轉型，大規模部署排在 2027
items.quote: larger rollouts in 2027
items.speaker: Darren Woods

items.quote: we plan to publish our annual global outlook in September

qa_flags.question: Arun Jayaram（JPMorgan）問荷莫茲海峽現況與 7 月情形
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 表示沒有太多額外的現場觀點，轉述媒體已報導，並改談市場影響與航運意願，未給 7 月具體情況

qa_flags.question: Neil Mehta（Goldman）問煉油獲利低於獨立煉廠預期，以及 Q3 走勢
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 與 CFO 以產品組合差異、變數多、預測難度解釋，未提供 Q3 數字或具體時點/營運因素拆解

qa_flags.question: Biraj Borkhataria（RBC）問歐洲暴利稅發生的可能性及與決策者的討論
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 以政策批評作答，說「不確定是否能阻止他們」，未給出可能性判斷或對公司影響數字

qa_flags.question: Bob Brackett（Bernstein）問歲修延後與把握高價機會的取捨
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 說「若能安全延後則納入考量」，改談歲修成本與工期改善，未說明本年實際延後的規模
